description:
Connect to Dremio or any other database that exposes an Arrow Flight SQL endpoint.

Apache Arrow Flight SQL is a modern open source protocol, co-created by Dremio, for querying SQL-based systems such as databases, data warehouses, and data lakehouses.
Download the open source Arrow Flight SQL ODBC driver to connect to Dremio or any other database that exposes an Arrow Flight SQL endpoint.
This is a Windows-only release.
What's New
- The Arrow Flight SQL ODBC driver now uses Apache Arrow version 25.0.1.

- OpenSSL library was updated to 3.6.2 to address potential security issues.

- You can now consume the driver logs through the standard streams (stderr).
